plan.name: v1.9.0-bridge
plan.info: Cross-chain bridge functionality - IBC and attested bridge support

title: Upgrade: v1.9.0-bridge
summary:
This upgrade introduces cross-chain bridge functionality to Mirage, enabling token transfers to and from external blockchains.

Bridge Architecture:
- IBC bridge for Cosmos ecosystem chains (Osmosis, Cosmos Hub, etc.)
- Attested bridge for non-IBC chains (Solana, Ethereum) using validator attestations

New Core Module Parameters:
- bridge_chains: Configuration for each supported bridge chain (empty by default)
- bridge_attestation_threshold: 6667 basis points (66.67% of voting power required for attestation)
- bridge_fee: 1,000,000 umirage (1 MIRAGE flat fee per bridge transfer, burned)

Bridge Chain Configuration:
- chain_id: Unique identifier (e.g., "solana", "ethereum", "osmosis")
- enabled: Whether bridging to/from this chain is active

Security Model:
- IBC transfers use standard Cosmos IBC security guarantees
- Non-IBC transfers require attestations from validators holding 66.67%+ of voting power
- All bridge transfers incur a flat 1 MIRAGE fee (burned)

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to the v1.9.0 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
